title: Independent review of all GLiNER retry attachments
question: What source-supported meaning did the attachments recovered by the full-coverage GLiNER retry preserve?
method: Read all fifteen retained attachments in the six published native retry tasks. Assess the exact term and content spans against the original source. Verify source and window anchors for all located candidate roles and assess their semantic quality through examples.

agents.separation: Assess attachments independently from the agent who ran the retry.

outputs.role: All retained attachments with original source locations and contexts
All located raw role candidates with validated source anchors
Native stage dispositions and indexed candidate rejections
Exact 375 retained model requests and replies
Independent individual attachment judgments and role diagnostics

results.name: Located raw roles with exact source-anchor checks

conclusion: All fifteen retry attachments were individually assessed. Six expressed an incomplete intended relation and nine were unsupported. The returned windows establish input coverage and retained role custody, while the attachment judgments identify incomplete formulas, wrong participant spans and unsupported citation links.
